description: This file defines classes and types related to WebSocket client management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class declarations for ConnectionMetaData and WebSocketEndPoint, which handle WebSocket connection metadata and endpoint operations respectively.

classes.name: ConnectionMetaData
classes.description: Manages metadata and state for a WebSocket connection, including handling open, fail, close, and message events.

classes.name: WebSocketEndPoint
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket client endpoint capable of connecting, sending messages, closing connections, and retrieving connection metadata.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection metadata with ID, handle, and URI.

methods.name: ~ConnectionMetaData
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up connection metadata.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection open event.

methods.name: onFail
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection failure event.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection close event.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: getHandle
methods.description: Returns the connection handle.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the connection identifier.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the connection.

methods.name: getLastMessage
methods.description: Returns the last received message.

methods.name: getErrorReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for any connection error.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URI associated with the connection.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Blocks until a WebSocket event occurs.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint
methods.description: Constructor for WebSocket endpoint management.

methods.name: ~WebSocketEndPoint
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the specified URI.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over a WebSocket connection and retrieves the response.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection with a given status code.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific connection ID.
